Kadget Remote for Android — control your Mac running Kadget from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Kadget › Tools › Kadget Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- feat(remote): monitor picker + all-screens view, three-finger Spaces / Mission Control / App Exposé (Kadget 3.12.0, Remote 1.11.0)
